purpose: Optional quest-dropping enemies and quest-starting interactables, placed beside existing route objectives. Equipment-only rares are excluded.
policy: Check only when already passing. Continue immediately if the target or usable object is absent.
New optional opportunities contribute zero XP and zero kills to the required route forecast.
Enemy pins are observed check areas, not promises of a fixed or available spawn.
Only use a starter or make its reward visit when that character actually has the item or active quest.
All newly added guide goals are note goals: they never hold a step.
Native pin format is /mappin <UiMapID> <x> <y>, with spaces and percent coordinates.

notes.text: OPTIONAL QUEST CHECK: /mappin 1418 39.0 46.0. While crossing the Badlands, watch for Malevolent Mirage's actual name and reddish aura; it can look like an ordinary animal. This is a reported sighting area, not a fixed spawn. If present, kill it together; everyone loots and uses their own Mirage Mirror. Continue if absent.

OPTIONAL REWARD IF HELD: Mirage Mirror goes to Mus'hale in Kargath, /mappin 1418 4.2 46.3. Use the looted mirror to start the quest first. Combine this with a normal Kargath return; no mirror means no extra stop.

OPTIONAL OBJECT CHECK: /mappin 1444 69.6 43.3. While near the Grimtotem camp, check the Grimtotem Chest by the diseased shaman remains for a Grimtotem Necklace. Keep it for the Broken Woodpaw Staff. The location is in current Forever data; if the container is absent or unusable, continue.

OPTIONAL OBJECT CHECK: /mappin 1444 66.4 50.9. If your Woodpaw circuit passes the dead diseased mystic, inspect the Woodpaw Bag for a Broken Woodpaw Staff. With a Grimtotem Necklace, combine the pieces out of combat into a Diseased Nature Staff and use it to start Corrupted Nature. The bag has a current map record; live loot and availability remain unverified. Skip if unavailable.

OPTIONAL BAG CHECK: If you found both Corrupted Nature components, combine the Grimtotem Necklace and Broken Woodpaw Staff out of combat, then use the Diseased Nature Staff. Follow any available in-game quest marker if you choose the extra event; its complete live sequence is not verified or required by this route.
